The model predicts optimal offloading decisions (local/edge/cloud) and resource allocation (CPU, bandwidth) based on task latency, energy, and server load. Privacy is preserved via local data retention.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Simulations show 34% lower average latency and 28% energy savings compared to DQN-based offloading. The federated approach reduces communication overhead by 60% versus centralized training. Meta-learning enables <5-episode adaptation to new device types, outperforming transfer learning by 22% in convergence speed.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Federated meta-learning enables efficient, privacy-preserving MEC-IoT orchestration. It balances global knowledge sharing with local adaptability—critical for scalable, heterogeneous IoT ecosystems. Future work includes integration with 6G network slicing.

title: ON SDN TO SUPPORT THE IEEE 802.11 AND C-V2X-BASED VEHICULAR COMMUNICATIONS USE-CASES AND PERFORMANCE: A COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY
author: Galih Nugraha Nurkahfi, Andy Triwinarko, Budi Prawara, Nasrullah Armi, Tutun Juhana, Nana Rachmana Syambas, Eueung Mulyana, Elhadj Dogheche, Iyad Dayoub

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Vehicular networks face challenges in scalability, latency, and interoperability between IEEE 802.11p/bd and C-V2X. Software-Defined Networking (SDN) offers centralized control and programmability to address these issues. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of SDN-enabled vehicular communication architectures.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The survey analyzes 80+ studies (2018–2023), categorizing SDN applications in VANETs into: (1) mobility-aware routing, (2) resource orchestration, (3) security management, and (4) multi-RAT handover. Performance metrics include latency, throughput, packet delivery ratio, and handover success rate.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: SDN reduces handover latency by 45–70% in hybrid 802.11/C-V2X networks. Centralized QoS enforcement improves video streaming PDR by 38%. However, controller placement (on-road RSU vs. cloud) introduces trade-offs between latency and coverage. Most studies focus on simulation; real-world testbeds remain limited.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: SDN is a transformative enabler for next-generation vehicular networks, particularly in heterogeneous environments. Standardization of southbound APIs and edge-based controller deployment are key to practical adoption. The survey identifies open challenges in security, slicing, and AI-native SDN.

title: ROBUST AUTOMOTIVE RADAR INTERFERENCE MITIGATION USING MULTIPLICATIVE-ADAPTIVE FILTERING AND HILBERT TRANSFORM
author: Budiman Putra Asmaur Rohman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Dayat Kurniawan, Ratna Indrawijaya, Chaeriah Bin Ali Wael, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: As automotive radar density increases, mutual interference becomes a critical issue, raising noise floors and masking targets. This paper proposes a novel interference mitigation technique combining multiplicative-adaptive filtering with Hilbert transform for robust target detection in congested environments.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The method processes FMCW radar signals by first applying Hilbert transform to extract analytic signals, then uses a multiplicative-adaptive LMS filter with dynamic step-size control to suppress interference while preserving target chirps. The step-size adapts based on signal variance to balance convergence speed and sidelobe suppression.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: In simulations with 5 interfering radars, the proposed method improves target SNR by 12.4 dB compared to conventional LMS. Detection range for weak targets (RCS = -10 dBsm) extends from 45 m to 82 m. False alarm rate drops by 63%, with minimal computational overhead (<5% CPU increase on automotive DSP).

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This technique effectively mitigates radar interference without requiring coordination between vehicles. Its low complexity makes it suitable for real-time automotive radar systems. Future work includes hardware-in-the-loop validation and integration with MIMO radar.

title: A NEW APPROACH TO JOINT RESOURCE MANAGEMENT IN MEC-IOT BASED FEDERATED META-LEARNING
author: Faustin Samafou, Bakhit Amine Adoum, Faitchou Marius Fidel, Ado Adamou Abba Ari, Amir Moungache, Nasrullah Armi, Abdelhak Mourad Gueroui

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Joint resource management in Mobile Edge Computing (MEC)-IoT systems is challenging due to heterogeneous task requirements and limited edge resources. This paper proposes FedMeta2Ag—a federated meta-learning framework that jointly optimizes task offloading and resource allocation while preserving data privacy.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: FedMeta2Ag combines federated learning with meta-learning to enable rapid adaptation to new IoT devices and workloads. Each edge server trains a local meta-model using device-specific task data, then aggregates updates to a global model. The framework predicts optimal CPU, bandwidth, and energy allocation per task. Evaluation uses MNIST as a proxy for IoT inference tasks under varying latency constraints.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: After 20 training epochs, FedMeta2Ag achieves 91.5% training accuracy and 92.0% test accuracy. It outperforms baseline federated and centralized approaches in prediction stability and convergence speed. Resource allocation errors are reduced by 31%, and average task latency drops by 27% compared to heuristic offloading.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: FedMeta2Ag demonstrates that meta-learning can enhance federated systems for dynamic MEC-IoT environments. Its ability to generalize across devices makes it suitable for scalable, privacy-aware edge intelligence. Future work includes integration with reinforcement learning for real-time adaptation.

title: PENGEMBANGAN SISTEM PERTANIAN TERPADU SKALA MIKRO BERBASIS IOT PADA FRONT-END WEBSITE
author: Wina Ayu Lestari, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Sistem Pertanian Terpadu Skala Mikro Berbasis IoT mengintegrasikan pertanian, peternakan, dan perikanan dalam satu platform digital. Penelitian ini fokus pada pengembangan antarmuka pengguna (front-end) website yang memungkinkan pemantauan dan kontrol real-time oleh petani.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Website dikembangkan menggunakan HTML5, CSS3, dan JavaScript dengan framework responsif. Pengujian melibatkan 79 responden yang mengisi kuesioner Google Form tentang kemudahan penggunaan, tata letak, kejelasan konten, dan navigasi. Responsivitas diuji menggunakan browser dev tools pada berbagai ukuran layar (mobile, tablet, desktop).

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Mayoritas responden (86%) memberikan penilaian 'baik' atau 'sangat baik' untuk tampilan dan fungsi website. Website responsif di semua perangkat—elemen tetap terlihat, teks mudah dibaca, dan navigasi intuitif. Namun, 22% pengguna menyarankan peningkatan kecepatan pemuatan dan penyederhanaan menu.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Front-end website berhasil menyediakan antarmuka yang user-friendly dan responsif untuk sistem pertanian terpadu. Rekomendasi perbaikan mencakup optimasi gambar dan lazy loading untuk meningkatkan performa. Sistem ini siap untuk integrasi penuh dengan back-end dan sensor IoT.

title: SISTEM PERTANIAN TERPADU SKALA MIKRO BERBASIS IOT PADA AYAM PETELUR
author: Nando Irawan Alsha, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Budidaya ayam petelur secara manual kurang efisien dalam penggunaan waktu dan sumber daya. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem IoT untuk memantau dan mengontrol suhu kandang secara otomatis, meningkatkan kesejahteraan ayam dan produktivitas telur.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sistem menggunakan sensor suhu DHT22 yang terhubung ke mikrokontroler. Jika suhu melebihi 25°C, kipas pendingin aktif secara otomatis. Data dikirim ke server dan dapat dipantau melalui website. Pengujian dilakukan selama 7 hari dalam kandang skala mikro dengan 50 ekor ayam.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem berhasil menjaga suhu kandang dalam rentang 23–25°C selama siang hari. Kipas aktif dalam 2 detik setelah suhu melebihi ambang batas. Konsumsi listrik rata-rata 0.8 kWh/hari. Petani melaporkan peningkatan kenyamanan dan pengurangan stres dalam pengelolaan harian.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Sistem IoT ini terbukti efektif dalam otomatisasi pengendalian suhu kandang ayam petelur. Desain modular memungkinkan integrasi dengan sensor kelembapan dan pemberi pakan otomatis di masa depan. Solusi ini sangat cocok untuk peternak skala mikro di daerah tropis.

title: PERANCANGAN BACK-END WEBSITE PADA SISTEM PERTANIAN TERPADU SKALA MIKRO BERBASIS IOT
author: Rivo Dwi Yulianto, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Back-end website merupakan tulang punggung sistem pertanian terpadu berbasis IoT, bertanggung jawab atas pengumpulan, pemrosesan, dan penyajian data sensor secara real-time dari sektor pertanian, peternakan, dan perikanan.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Back-end dikembangkan menggunakan Node.js dan Express, dengan database MongoDB untuk menyimpan data sensor (suhu, pH, kekeruhan, dll.). RESTful API digunakan untuk komunikasi antara sensor, front-end, dan database. Arsitektur mendukung skalabilitas dan keamanan melalui autentikasi JWT.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem mampu menangani 50+ sensor dengan latency rata-rata 320 ms. Data tersedia secara real-time di front-end dengan refresh rate 5 detik. Uji beban menunjukkan stabilitas hingga 200 permintaan per menit. Backup otomatis dijalankan setiap 6 jam.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Back-end yang dirancang memenuhi kebutuhan sistem pertanian terpadu dalam hal real-time data handling, keandalan, dan keamanan. Arsitektur modular memungkinkan penambahan sektor atau sensor baru tanpa modifikasi besar. Sistem siap untuk deployment skala luas.

title: SISTEM PERTANIAN TERPADU SKALA MIKRO BERBASIS IOT PADA IKAN LELE
author: Aurellia Kartika Estiningtyas, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Budidaya ikan lele memerlukan pemantauan ketat terhadap kualitas air. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem IoT untuk memantau kekeruhan dan pH air, serta mengaktifkan sirkulasi air secara otomatis saat parameter melebihi ambang batas.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sensor turbiditas (NTU) dan pH dipasang di kolam lele. Jika pH <6.5 atau >8.5, atau kekeruhan >50 NTU, pompa sirkulasi aktif selama 10 menit. Sistem dikontrol oleh Arduino dan data dikirim ke cloud. Pengujian dilakukan selama 10 hari pada kolam berukuran 1m³.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem berhasil mempertahankan pH dalam rentang 6.8–7.9 dan kekeruhan <40 NTU. Pompa aktif rata-rata 3 kali/hari. Kelangsungan hidup ikan meningkat dari 82% (manual) menjadi 96%. Konsumsi air berkurang 25% berkat sirkulasi tertutup.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Sistem IoT ini meningkatkan efisiensi dan keberlanjutan budidaya lele skala mikro. Otomatisasi mengurangi ketergantungan pada intervensi manual dan mencegah stres ikan akibat fluktuasi kualitas air. Desain hemat energi membuatnya layak untuk daerah terpencil.

title: MULTI-FUNCTION COASTAL RADAR FOR TSUNAMI DETECTION AND OCEAN TIDE AND WAVE MONITORING
author: Tjahjo Adiprabowo, Yuyu Wahyu, Goib Wiranto, Nasrullah Armi, Asif Awaludin, Ginaldi Ari Nugroho, Pamungkas Daud, Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Aloysius Adya Pramudita, Yudi Yuliyus Maulana, Folin Oktafiani, Teguh Praludi, Berlian Surya Wicaksana, Riyani Jana Yanti, Suryanto Suryanto, Rizky Rahmatullah, Yana Taryana, Suisbiyanto Prasetya, Ding-Bing Lin

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Indonesia memerlukan sistem deteksi tsunami dini yang andal. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem radar pantai berbasis SIMRAD Halo 6 yang mampu mendeteksi gelombang tsunami hingga 100 km dari pantai, dikombinasikan dengan sensor tekanan laut (SBE 26Plus) untuk validasi.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Radar SIMRAD dipasang di ketinggian pantai, sedangkan SBE 26Plus ditempatkan di dasar laut untuk mengukur tekanan dan ketinggian air. Data radar (clutter dari permukaan laut) diproses menjadi citra gelombang real-time. Algoritma deteksi tsunami memantau anomali kenaikan permukaan laut secara tiba-tiba.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem berhasil mendeteksi simulasi tsunami buatan dengan ketinggian 0.5 m dari jarak 45 km dalam waktu <90 detik. Integrasi dengan SBE 26Plus meningkatkan akurasi deteksi menjadi 94%. GUI menampilkan peta gelombang dan notifikasi darurat secara real-time.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Sistem radar multi-fungsi ini memberikan solusi deteksi tsunami dini yang cepat, akurat, dan terjangkau. Kemampuannya untuk memantau pasang surut dan gelombang juga mendukung navigasi dan penelitian kelautan. Rekomendasi: perluasan jaringan radar di wilayah rawan tsunami.

title: OPTIMASI PENGINDERAAN SPEKTRUM PADA RADIO KOGNITIF UNTUK MENGATASI KELANGKAAN FREKUENSI DALAM SISTEM KOMUNIKASI NIRKABEL
author: Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Kelangkaan spektrum frekuensi disebabkan oleh alokasi statis yang tidak efisien. Radio kognitif menawarkan solusi melalui penginderaan spektrum dinamis, memungkinkan pengguna sekunder memanfaatkan spektrum yang tidak digunakan oleh pengguna primer.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Penelitian ini menganalisis dua pendekatan: (1) overlay—mendeteksi celah spektrum dan mengaksesnya tanpa mengganggu pengguna primer, dan (2) underlay—menggunakan ultra-wideband dengan daya sangat rendah. Fokus utama adalah pada teknik penginderaan spektrum berbasis energi dan matched filter.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Pendekatan overlay memberikan throughput 3.2× lebih tinggi daripada underlay dalam skenario low-traffic. Namun, underlay lebih stabil di lingkungan noise tinggi. Teknik hybrid yang menggabungkan keduanya mengurangi probabilitas miss detection menjadi <5% pada SNR = -10 dB.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Penginderaan spektrum yang optimal memerlukan adaptasi berbasis kondisi lingkungan. Radio kognitif berpotensi merevolusi efisiensi spektrum, terutama untuk 6G dan IoT masif. Tantangan ke depan meliputi standarisasi dan mitigasi serangan keamanan.

title: RANDOM SAMPLE CONSENSUS-BASED ROOM MAPPING USING LIGHT DETECTION AND RANGING
author: Merlyn Inova Christie Latukolan, Aloysius Adya Pramudita, Nasrullah Armi, Nizar Alam Hamdani, Helfy Susilawati, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Pemetaan ruangan menggunakan LiDAR sering mengalami kehilangan data akibat refleksi atau halangan. Penelitian ini menerapkan algoritma RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) untuk merekonstruksi garis dinding yang hilang dari point cloud 2D.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Data dikumpulkan menggunakan YDLiDAR G4 (7 Hz) di ruangan 5.76m × 4.95m. Point cloud diproses di MATLAB dengan RANSAC untuk line fitting. Parameter jarak maksimum xy digunakan untuk memfilter outlier dan meningkatkan akurasi model garis.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: RANSAC berhasil merekonstruksi 92% garis dinding yang terputus. Akurasi sudut rata-rata 1.8°, dan kesalahan jarak <3 cm. Semakin banyak titik data, semakin tinggi probabilitas model yang benar (korelasi r = 0.89). Waktu pemrosesan rata-rata 1.2 detik per pemindaian.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: RANSAC terbukti efektif untuk pemetaan ruangan berbasis LiDAR dengan data tidak lengkap. Metode ini cocok untuk robotika dan navigasi indoor. Pengembangan selanjutnya akan mencakup pemetaan 3D dan integrasi SLAM.

title: PENERAPAN TEKNOLOGI INTERNET OF THINGS (IOT) PADA BUDIDAYA AKUAPONIK IKAN PATIN
author: Rafif Tian Isnanta, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Sistem akuaponik menggabungkan budidaya ikan patin dan tanaman pakcoy, tetapi memerlukan pemantauan ketat terhadap kualitas air. Penelitian ini menerapkan IoT untuk otomatisasi pemantauan pH, suhu, dan pemberian pakan.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sensor pH, suhu, dan turbiditas dipasang di tangki akuaponik. Mikrokontroler mengontrol pompa sirkulasi dan pemberi pakan berdasarkan jadwal dan kondisi air. Data dikirim ke cloud dan dapat diakses via smartphone. Sistem diuji selama 30 hari.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: pH dipertahankan pada 6.8–7.2, suhu 26–28°C. Pakan diberikan 3x/hari secara otomatis. Kelangsungan hidup ikan patin mencapai 94%, dan pertumbuhan pakcoy 20% lebih cepat dibanding sistem manual. Konsumsi listrik: 1.1 kWh/hari.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: IoT meningkatkan stabilitas ekosistem akuaponik dan mengurangi beban kerja petani. Sistem ini layak untuk skala rumah tangga dan UMKM. Pengembangan selanjutnya mencakup prediksi panen berbasis AI dan integrasi energi surya.

title: PENERAPAN TEKNOLOGI INTERNET OF THINGS BERBASIS WEB PADA BUDIDAYA AKUAPONIK TUMBUHAN PAKCOY
author: Hilmi Rifa Ghifary, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Sistem akuaponik menggabungkan budidaya ikan dan tanaman pakcoy dalam satu ekosistem tertutup, di mana limbah ikan menjadi nutrisi alami bagi tanaman. Namun, sistem ini memerlukan pemantauan intensif terhadap parameter seperti pH, suhu, kekeruhan, dan ketinggian air. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem IoT berbasis web untuk otomatisasi dan pemantauan real-time.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sistem menggunakan sensor pH, suhu, turbiditas, dan level air yang terhubung ke mikrokontroler ESP32. Data dikirim ke platform cloud (Blynk) dan ditampilkan melalui antarmuka web responsif. Pengguna dapat memantau kondisi akuaponik dari mana saja dan menerima notifikasi jika parameter melebihi ambang batas.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem berhasil mempertahankan pH dalam rentang optimal (6.5–7.5) dan suhu air 26–28°C selama 30 hari pengujian. Web interface menampilkan data secara real-time dengan latency <2 detik. Akurasi sensor mencapai 92% dibandingkan alat ukur laboratorium. Petani melaporkan pengurangan 70% waktu pemantauan manual.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: IoT berbasis web terbukti meningkatkan efisiensi dan keberlanjutan budidaya akuaponik skala mikro. Sistem ini mudah diadopsi oleh petani perkotaan dan UMKM. Pengembangan selanjutnya mencakup integrasi pemberi pakan otomatis dan prediksi pertumbuhan tanaman berbasis AI.

title: ALAT PENDETEKSI GAS BUANG MOBIL MENGGUNAKAN SENSOR MQ-135
author: Ridho Armanda, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Emisi gas buang mobil mengandung polutan berbahaya seperti CO, NO₂, dan NH₃ yang dapat membahayakan kesehatan dan lingkungan. Alat ini dirancang untuk memantau konsentrasi gas secara real-time, memberikan umpan balik langsung kepada pengemudi untuk meningkatkan keselamatan dan perawatan kendaraan.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sensor gas MQ-135 dipasang di dekat saluran knalpot dan terhubung ke mikrokontroler ESP32. Data dikirim ke platform Blynk Cloud melalui Wi-Fi. Sistem diuji pada kondisi idle dan berkendara, dengan kalibrasi terhadap gas referensi standar.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Rata-rata emisi terukur: 946 ppm saat idle dan 1235 ppm saat berkendara. Sistem memberikan respons dalam 3 detik dengan akurasi ±8%. Notifikasi peringatan muncul ketika konsentrasi melebihi 1500 ppm. Konsumsi daya rata-rata 0.9 W, memungkinkan operasi jangka panjang.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Alat ini memberikan solusi murah dan real-time untuk pemantauan emisi kendaraan. Tantangan ke depan meliputi peningkatan ketahanan sensor terhadap suhu ekstrem dan integrasi dengan sistem diagnosa kendaraan (OBD-II). Desain modular memungkinkan adaptasi untuk truk dan sepeda motor.

title: PERANCANGAN SISTEM TRANSMISI DATA KESEHATAN MOBIL MENGGUNAKAN DHT22
author: Bimo Wiko, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Kondisi mesin dan transmisi mobil yang tidak terpantau dapat menyebabkan kegagalan mendadak dan kecelakaan. Penelitian ini merancang sistem transmisi data kesehatan mobil berbasis sensor suhu DHT22 untuk memantau suhu mesin dan transmisi secara real-time.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sensor DHT22 dipasang pada blok mesin dan gearbox. Data dikirim via ESP32 ke dashboard berbasis web. Sistem mencatat suhu rata-rata saat idle dan berkendara, serta memberikan peringatan dini jika suhu melebihi ambang aman (85°C untuk transmisi, 105°C untuk mesin).

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Pengujian menunjukkan suhu transmisi rata-rata 28°C (idle) dan 70°C (berkendara), sedangkan suhu mesin 54°C (idle) dan 92°C (berkendara). Sistem mendeteksi anomali pemanasan berlebih dalam 5 detik. Akurasi pengukuran ±1.5°C dibandingkan termometer inframerah.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Sistem ini meningkatkan kesadaran pengemudi terhadap kondisi kendaraan dan mencegah kerusakan akibat overheating. Pengembangan selanjutnya akan menambahkan sensor tekanan oli dan getaran mesin untuk diagnosis lebih komprehensif.

title: PERANCANGAN DAN IMPLEMENTASI SISTEM PENGENDALI NUTRISI DAN PH PADA BUAH MELON HIDROPONIK IRIGASI TETES BERBASIS IOT
author: Muhamad Fauzan, Achmad Ali Muayyadi, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Budidaya melon hidroponik di lahan kering memerlukan kontrol ketat terhadap nutrisi dan pH larutan. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem IoT untuk memantau dan mengatur pH serta konsentrasi nutrisi (TDS) secara otomatis melalui irigasi tetes.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sistem menggunakan sensor pH, TDS, dan suhu yang terhubung ke NodeMCU ESP32. Data dikirim ke aplikasi Blynk. Jika pH <5.8 atau >6.4, pompa dosing asam/basa aktif. Irigasi tetes diatur berdasarkan kebutuhan harian tanaman. Pengujian dilakukan selama 45 hari pada 20 tanaman melon.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem menjaga pH dalam rentang 5.9–6.3 dan TDS 1200–1400 ppm. Akurasi sensor pH ±0.2 unit, TDS ±30 ppm. Tanaman menunjukkan pertumbuhan seragam dan hasil panen 15% lebih tinggi dibanding kontrol manual. Aplikasi Blynk stabil dengan uptime 99.2%.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Sistem IoT ini meningkatkan efisiensi penggunaan air dan nutrisi dalam budidaya melon hidroponik. Otomatisasi mengurangi ketergantungan pada keahlian teknis petani. Rekomendasi: tambahkan sensor kelembapan tanah dan prediksi panen berbasis data historis.

title: IMPROVEMENT OF LR-FHSS LPWAN SATELLITE COMMUNICATION FOR IOMT
author: Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Elhadj Dogheche, Iyad Dayoub, Kevin Stekelorom, Denis Remiens, Nasrullah Armi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) memerlukan konektivitas global, terutama di daerah terpencil. LPWAN berbasis satelit (LEO) menawarkan solusi, tetapi menghadapi tantangan seperti latency tinggi, attenuasi sinyal, dan tabrakan paket. Penelitian ini meningkatkan kinerja LR-FHSS (Long Range – Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum) untuk komunikasi satelit-IoT.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Studi simulasi menganalisis probabilitas keberhasilan transmisi pada jarak 2000 km (orbit LEO). Parameter kunci: Time on Air (ToA), spreading factor, bandwidth, dan daya transmisi. Performa dievaluasi berdasarkan packet delivery ratio (PDR), latency, dan konsumsi energi pada skenario multi-node.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: LR-FHSS meningkatkan PDR dari 68% (LoRa standar) menjadi 91% pada SNR = -5 dB. ToA rata-rata 1.8 detik, cukup untuk aplikasi IoMT non-kritis (e.g., pemantauan kronis). Konsumsi energi per paket berkurang 22% berkat hopping adaptif. Sistem mendukung hingga 500 node per satelit tanpa degradasi signifikan.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: LR-FHSS terbukti efektif untuk komunikasi satelit-IoMT jarak jauh. Teknologi ini memungkinkan layanan kesehatan digital di daerah terpencil. Tantangan ke depan: mitigasi Doppler shift dan integrasi dengan protokol keamanan end-to-end untuk data medis sensitif.

title: Revolutionizing Vascular Monitoring
author: Kevin Stekelorom, Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Karim Dogheche, Nasrullah Armi, Iyad Dayoub, Denis Remiens, El Hadj Dogheche

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Cardiovascular diseases remain a leading cause of mortality worldwide, often exacerbated by the lack of continuous, non-invasive monitoring tools. The European Interreg VASCULAI project addresses this gap by developing an intelligent electronic bracelet capable of measuring heart rate, blood pressure, and blood flow in real time. This wearable leverages AI to analyze physiological data and predict vascular anomalies before they become critical.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The IEMN/UPHF team, in collaboration with BRIN (Indonesia’s National Research and Innovation Agency), is building prototypes in two phases. Phase 1 uses commercial off-the-shelf sensors to validate data acquisition and wireless transmission. Phase 2 focuses on developing custom electronic components using innovative materials for enhanced sensitivity and comfort. BRIN contributes expertise in secure short- and long-range communication protocols to ensure data integrity and privacy.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Initial prototypes successfully capture pulse waveforms and estimate systolic/diastolic pressure with 89% correlation to clinical devices. Wireless transmission over Bluetooth and LoRaWAN demonstrates <2% packet loss in urban and rural testbeds. AI models trained on multi-parameter data show early promise in detecting arterial stiffness—a key predictor of hypertension and stroke.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This interdisciplinary effort bridges European and Indonesian research strengths to create a next-generation vascular monitoring platform. The system’s potential extends beyond clinical use to preventive healthcare in remote communities. Future work includes miniaturization, energy harvesting integration, and large-scale clinical validation across diverse populations.

title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for 6G and Beyond: A Comprehensive Survey from Theory to Deployment
author: Prasetyo Putranto, Anis Amazigh Hamza, Sameh Mabrouki, Nasrullah Armi, Iyad Dayoub

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: As 6G research accelerates, Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) have emerged as a transformative technology to manipulate electromagnetic waves and overcome signal blockage in complex environments. Unlike traditional relays, RIS are passive, low-cost, and energy-efficient, making them ideal for smart radio environments.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: This survey synthesizes over 200 recent publications to provide a holistic view of RIS—from theoretical foundations (e.g., channel modeling, optimization) to practical deployment (e.g., control architectures, channel estimation, standardization). The authors categorize RIS applications into urban, indoor, and vehicular scenarios, and critically assess hardware constraints, energy efficiency, and scalability.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Key findings include: (1) RIS can improve spectral efficiency by 3–5× in mmWave bands; (2) hybrid RIS (with limited active elements) offer the best trade-off between performance and complexity; (3) standardization efforts (e.g., by 3GPP and IEEE) are still nascent but progressing rapidly. The survey also identifies gaps in real-world channel sounding and long-term reliability testing.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: RIS is poised to become a cornerstone of 6G networks, but its transition from lab to field requires co-design across physics, signal processing, and network architecture. This survey serves as a roadmap for researchers and industry stakeholders to navigate the multidisciplinary challenges of RIS deployment.

title: Hubungan Pengetahuan dan Sikap terhadap Kejadian Anemia pada Remaja Putri di SMK YM Tahun 2024
author: Syahrul Rudiansyah, Wili Sulfiah, Lita Anggraini, Selviana Ningsih, Nasya Nurmaulina

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Anemia among adolescent girls is a significant public health concern in Indonesia, affecting physical growth, cognitive function, and academic performance. This study investigates whether knowledge and attitudes toward nutrition and health influence anemia prevalence among female students at SMK YM.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: A cross-sectional descriptive study was conducted with 195 female students from grades X and XI. Data were collected through questionnaires and hemoglobin tests. Statistical analysis used chi-square tests to examine associations between knowledge, attitude, and anemia status (hemoglobin <12 g/dL).

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The study found no statistically significant relationship between knowledge (p = 0.078) or attitude (p = 0.276) and anemia occurrence. However, other factors—such as dietary habits and menstrual patterns—were identified as potential contributors to low hemoglobin levels in this cohort.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: While knowledge and attitude are important, they may not be sufficient to prevent anemia without addressing structural and behavioral determinants. The findings suggest that school-based interventions should combine education with practical support, such as iron supplementation and balanced meal programs.

title: Comprehensive Analysis of Hybrid Approaches to Li-Fi and LPWAN Systems for IoT with Satellite-Assisted Communication
author: Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Kevin Stekelorom, Elhadj Dogheche, Nasrullah Armi, Denis Remiens, Iyad Dayoub

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Telemedicine in remote areas faces dual challenges: high-bandwidth needs for medical imaging (e.g., X-rays) and long-range connectivity for data transmission. This research proposes a hybrid communication system that fuses Li-Fi for ultra-fast indoor data transfer and LPWAN (LoRa) for wide-area coverage, augmented by satellite links for global reach.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system integrates Li-Fi (up to 5 Gbps) for point-to-point hospital room communication and LoRa (366 bps–6.8 kbps) for rural sensor networks. A Cross-Technology Communication (CTC) layer enables seamless data handoff between protocols. Satellite backhaul (LEO) ensures connectivity in medical deserts. Performance is evaluated via end-to-end latency, throughput, and energy consumption.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The hybrid system reduces transmission time for a 100 MB X-ray from 4.2 hours (LoRa alone) to 0.16 seconds (Li-Fi + satellite relay). Energy efficiency improves by 37% compared to cellular alternatives. The CTC layer achieves 98% packet delivery across protocol transitions, even under mobility and interference.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This architecture enables real-time, high-fidelity telemedicine in underserved regions. Future work includes dynamic resource allocation based on medical urgency and integration with IoMT edge AI for on-device diagnostics.

title: Pembuatan Sistem Informasi Untuk Kendaraan Listrik Otonom Berbasis Website
author: Aprillia Damayanti, Denden Mohamad Arifin, Ardian Infantono, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Mohammed Ikrom Asysyakuur, Raden Aditya Satria Ema

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Perkembangan teknologi website telah menjadikannya sebagai sarana utama penyebaran informasi yang cepat, mudah diakses, dan efisien. Dalam konteks kendaraan listrik otonom, keberadaan sistem informasi berbasis web memungkinkan pemantauan, kontrol, dan promosi layanan secara real-time kepada pengguna dan operator.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Penelitian ini merancang dan mengembangkan sistem informasi berbasis website untuk kendaraan listrik otonom. Sistem mencakup antarmuka pengguna untuk menampilkan status kendaraan, rute, dan layanan terkait. Teknologi web modern digunakan untuk memastikan responsivitas dan kompatibilitas lintas perangkat.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem berhasil menyediakan platform terpadu yang memungkinkan pengguna mengakses informasi kendaraan listrik otonom dari mana saja. Website menawarkan kemudahan navigasi, kecepatan akses, dan integrasi dengan sistem backend untuk pembaruan data real-time.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Pengembangan sistem informasi berbasis website menjadi langkah penting dalam adopsi kendaraan listrik otonom di Indonesia. Sistem ini tidak hanya mendukung operasional teknis, tetapi juga berperan dalam edukasi dan pemasaran kepada masyarakat luas.

title: Sistem Pendeteksi Pejalan Kaki Di Lingkungan Terbatas Berbasis SSD MobileNet V2 Dengan Menggunakan Gambar 360° Ternormalisasi
author: Nafisun Nufus, Denden Mohamad Arifin, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Raden Aditya Satria Nugraha, Mohammed Ikrom Asysyakuur, NNA Marlina, CH Parangin, Ema

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Kendaraan otonom harus mampu mendeteksi pejalan kaki secara akurat untuk mencegah kecelakaan. Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem deteksi pejalan kaki berbasis deep learning yang dioptimalkan untuk lingkungan terbatas seperti kampus atau area perkantoran.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sistem menggunakan arsitektur SSD MobileNet V2 yang ringan dan efisien, dipasangkan dengan kamera 360°. Gambar input dinormalisasi untuk meningkatkan konsistensi deteksi. Dataset dikumpulkan dari lingkungan nyata dengan berbagai kondisi pencahayaan dan keramaian.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Model menunjukkan performa tinggi dalam mendeteksi pejalan kaki bahkan dalam kondisi padat. Kecepatan inferensi mencapai 25 FPS pada perangkat edge, menjadikannya cocok untuk implementasi real-time pada kendaraan otonom skala kecil.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Pendekatan berbasis SSD MobileNet V2 dengan gambar 360° ternormalisasi terbukti efektif untuk deteksi pejalan kaki di area terbatas. Sistem ini memberikan keseimbangan optimal antara akurasi, kecepatan, dan efisiensi daya.

title: Pengembangan Software Aplikasi Pendeteksian Objek Berbasis LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging)
author: Raden Aditya Satria Nugraha, Denden Mohamad Arifin, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Mohammed Ikrom Asysyakuur, Ema Nufus, Santi, NNAM, Habibi, A

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: LiDAR merupakan teknologi kunci dalam sistem persepsi kendaraan otonom. Penelitian ini mengembangkan perangkat lunak untuk pendeteksian objek berbasis data point cloud dari sensor LiDAR, sebagai bagian dari sistem kendaraan listrik otonom.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Aplikasi dikembangkan menggunakan library pemrosesan point cloud dan algoritma segmentasi objek. Data LiDAR diproses untuk mengidentifikasi objek statis dan dinamis di sekitar kendaraan. Antarmuka pengguna memungkinkan visualisasi 3D dari hasil deteksi.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem mampu mendeteksi kendaraan, pejalan kaki, dan rintangan dengan akurasi tinggi dalam berbagai kondisi cuaca. Waktu pemrosesan rata-rata 80 ms per frame, memenuhi kebutuhan real-time untuk kendaraan berkecepatan rendah.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Perangkat lunak ini menjadi fondasi penting bagi pengembangan kendaraan otonom di Indonesia. Integrasi dengan sensor lain (kamera, radar) akan menjadi langkah selanjutnya untuk meningkatkan ketahanan sistem.

title: Research Civil Aircraft Model (RCAM) Dengan Metode Dinamis 6 Derajat Kebebasan Menggunakan MATLAB
author: Aulia Widya Prameswari, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Denden Mohamad Ariffin

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Simulasi penerbangan memerlukan model dinamis yang akurat. Penelitian ini mengimplementasikan Research Civil Aircraft Model (RCAM) — model pesawat sipil berbasis Boeing 757 — menggunakan pendekatan 6 derajat kebebasan (6-DOF) di MATLAB.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Model mencakup 3 translasi (x, y, z) dan 3 rotasi (pitch, roll, yaw). Parameter aerodinamis, massa, dan pusat gravitasi diintegrasikan ke dalam algoritma simulasi. Sistem kontrol throttle dan defleksi permukaan juga dimodelkan untuk respons realistis.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Simulasi berhasil mereplikasi perilaku penerbangan RCAM dalam berbagai skenario manuver. Model menunjukkan stabilitas dinamis yang konsisten dengan data referensi dari proyek GARTEUR.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Implementasi RCAM berbasis MATLAB memberikan platform edukasi dan riset yang fleksibel untuk studi dinamika penerbangan. Model ini dapat diperluas untuk uji algoritma autopilot atau sistem navigasi canggih.

title: HOG Based Pedestrian Detection System for Autonomous Vehicle Operated in Limited Area
author: Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Samratul Fuady, Arumjeni Mitayani, Yuyu Wahyu Sari

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Deteksi pejalan kaki adalah komponen kritis dalam sistem kendaraan otonom. Penelitian ini mengusulkan sistem berbasis Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) dan Support Vector Machine (SVM) untuk lingkungan kampus terbatas.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Dataset terdiri dari 2000 gambar jalan kampus dengan dan tanpa pejalan kaki. 90% digunakan untuk pelatihan, 10% untuk pengujian. Fitur HOG diekstraksi dan diklasifikasikan menggunakan SVM untuk mengenali keberadaan dan jumlah pejalan kaki (0–4 orang).

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Sistem mencapai akurasi 98.00% dalam mengklasifikasikan jumlah pejalan kaki. Waktu deteksi rata-rata 45 ms per frame, memungkinkan implementasi real-time pada perangkat embedded.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Pendekatan HOG-SVM terbukti efektif dan efisien untuk deteksi pejalan kaki di area terbatas. Meskipun kalah canggih dibanding deep learning, metode ini menawarkan kompleksitas rendah dan interpretabilitas tinggi.

title: WiFi-AC Based Telecommunication Infrastructure for Autonomous Vehicle in Limited Area
author: Andri Fachrur Rozie, Galih Nugraha Nurkahfi, Suyoto, Vita Awalia Mardiana, Arumjeni Mitayani, Mochamad Mardi Marta Dinata, Dikdik Krisnandi, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Ana Heryana

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Kendaraan otonom memerlukan infrastruktur komunikasi yang andal. Standar IEEE 802.11p mahal dan kurang tersedia di Indonesia. Penelitian ini mengevaluasi IEEE 802.11ac (WiFi-AC) sebagai alternatif untuk area terbatas seperti kawasan perkantoran.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Infrastruktur diuji dalam berbagai skenario dengan parameter: throughput, delay, jitter, dan packet loss. Pengujian dilakukan di lingkungan jalan perkantoran dengan kendaraan otonom prototipe.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: WiFi-AC menunjukkan kinerja yang baik: throughput >80 Mbps, delay <10 ms, jitter <1 ms, dan packet loss <0.5%. Sistem mampu mendukung komunikasi V2I (Vehicle-to-Infrastructure) untuk kendaraan otonom sederhana.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: IEEE 802.11ac merupakan solusi hemat biaya dan mudah diimplementasikan untuk kendaraan otonom di area terbatas. Hasil ini membuka jalan bagi adopsi teknologi komunikasi berbasis WiFi yang sudah tersedia luas di Indonesia.

title: User Expectation of Public Transport Design Experience for Electric Bike Sharing in Indonesia
author: Y. M. K. Syabana, K. H. Sanjaya, G. B. Park, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Banyak masyarakat Indonesia masih enggan menggunakan transportasi umum. Penelitian ini mengeksplorasi harapan pengguna terhadap sistem berbagi sepeda listrik (EBS) sebagai solusi first-mile/last-mile dalam ekosistem transportasi terpadu.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Studi menggunakan Focus Group Interview (FGI) dengan 10 mahasiswa Indonesia di Daegu, Korea Selatan, yang berpengalaman menggunakan transportasi umum di kedua negara. Data dianalisis untuk mengidentifikasi kesenjangan antara harapan dan realitas.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Partisipan menginginkan EBS yang aman, nyaman, terjangkau, dan terintegrasi dengan aplikasi pembayaran digital. Dua skenario penggunaan diusulkan: (1) EBS untuk koneksi stasiun-Kampus, (2) EBS untuk wisata perkotaan.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Temuan ini memberikan arahan desain yang konkret untuk pengembangan EBS di Indonesia. Rekomendasi telah diajukan kepada pembuat kebijakan transportasi untuk mempercepat adopsi mobilitas berkelanjutan.

title: UTILIZATION OF THE RANSAC METHOD TO VALIDATE THE RECONSTRUCTION OF 2-DIMENSIONAL OBJECTS USING LIDAR
author: T. Mulyana, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, S. D. Siswanti

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Rekonstruksi objek 2D dari data LiDAR sering terganggu oleh data anomali (noise, pantulan ganda). Penelitian ini memanfaatkan metode Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) untuk memvalidasi dan memperbaiki akurasi rekonstruksi objek.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Algoritma RANSAC diterapkan pada point cloud 2D untuk mengidentifikasi model garis yang paling konsisten. Data anomali dihapus berdasarkan deviasi dari model. Analisis dilakukan menggunakan MATLAB, dengan hasil divalidasi melalui regresi linear dan metode Least Square.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: RANSAC berhasil mengurangi kesalahan rekonstruksi hingga 63% dibanding metode konvensional. Sistem mampu membedakan objek nyata dari noise dengan presisi tinggi, meningkatkan keandalan sistem navigasi kendaraan otonom.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Integrasi RANSAC dalam pipeline pemrosesan LiDAR terbukti efektif untuk validasi objek 2D. Pendekatan ini dapat diadopsi secara luas dalam sistem robotika dan kendaraan otonom untuk meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap gangguan lingkungan.

title: Multipose to Detect Airport Visitor Behavior
author: N.K.E. Iswarawati, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Heni Puspita, Prio Adjie Utomo, R.A. Putri

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Airport security is critical due to the high risk of criminal activities by unidentified visitors. Traditional surveillance lacks behavioral insight. This research proposes a human pose estimation system to detect suspicious behaviors—such as loitering, erratic movements, or concealed gestures—by analyzing 17 key body joints using multipose estimation.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system uses a deep learning-based multipose estimation model (e.g., OpenPose) to extract skeletal keypoints from CCTV footage. Behavioral features are derived from joint trajectories, velocity, and posture angles. Anomaly detection is performed using threshold-based rules and machine learning classifiers trained on labeled suspicious/normal behavior datasets collected in simulated airport environments.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The system achieves 92.3% accuracy in detecting predefined suspicious postures (e.g., crouching near restricted zones, prolonged stationary stance). False alarm rate is 4.1% in controlled tests. Real-time processing at 15 FPS is achieved on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier, making it suitable for edge deployment in airport security infrastructure.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Multipose-based behavioral analysis offers a non-intrusive, privacy-preserving method for enhancing airport security. Future work includes integration with facial recognition (opt-in) and federated learning to improve detection across diverse demographics without centralizing sensitive data.

title: Cooperative Line Formation Control of Multi-Agent Systems Based on Least Squares Estimation
author: Samratul Fuady, Arumjeni Mitayani, Ario Birmiawan Widyoutomo, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Alexander Christantho Budiman, Suyoto, Mochamad Mardi Marta Dinata

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Cooperative control of multi-agent systems is essential for applications like drone swarms, autonomous convoys, and robotic teams. This paper addresses the problem of distributed line formation, where agents must align along a common line using only local neighbor information.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Each agent computes a local cost function based on the squared distance to a line estimated via Least Squares Estimation (LSE) from its own and neighbors’ positions. A distributed subgradient method minimizes the global cost (sum of local costs) without centralized coordination. Simulations use 10–50 agents in 2D space with communication graphs.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The proposed method converges to a straight-line formation within 12 seconds for 20 agents, with final alignment error <0.05 m. It outperforms consensus-based approaches in convergence speed and robustness to communication delays. Energy consumption is reduced by 18% due to smoother trajectories.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: LSE-based distributed control provides an efficient, scalable solution for line formation. The method is extendable to other geometric patterns (e.g., circles, grids) and resilient to agent failures. Future work will test on physical robot fleets.

title: Image Super Resolution Using ESRGAN: A Preliminary Experimental Study
author: Bella Wahmilyana Asril, Effrina Yanti Hamid, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Salita Ulitia Prini

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Low-resolution images limit visual quality in medical imaging, surveillance, and remote sensing. Super-resolution (SR) techniques enhance image detail, and deep learning has revolutionized this field. This study explores the Enhanced Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Network (ESRGAN) for realistic texture generation.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: ESRGAN is trained on DIV2K dataset (800 high-res images) to upscale images by 4×. The perceptual loss combines content, adversarial, and texture losses. Evaluation uses PSNR, SSIM, and subjective visual quality on test sets including natural scenes and medical X-rays.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: ESRGAN achieves PSNR of 28.7 dB and SSIM of 0.82 on Set5, outperforming bicubic interpolation (24.1 dB, 0.68). Visual results show realistic textures (e.g., hair, fabric) without blurring. However, it occasionally introduces artifacts in smooth regions like skies.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: ESRGAN provides superior perceptual quality for image enhancement, making it suitable for applications where visual realism matters more than pixel accuracy. Future work includes lightweight variants for mobile deployment and domain-specific fine-tuning.

title: A Method of Anti-Windup PID Controller for a BLDC-Drive System
author: Aditya Adni Argaloka, Harwin Aptadarya, Fiendo Mahendra Arentaka, Fiky Yosef Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Brushless DC (BLDC) motors are widely used in electric vehicles but suffer from integral windup in PID controllers during saturation, causing overshoot and instability. This research implements an anti-windup PID controller to improve speed regulation under load variations.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The anti-windup mechanism limits integrator accumulation when control output saturates. Controller gains are tuned using MATLAB PID Tuner. The system is implemented on Arduino IDE with a BLDC motor driver. Tests include step responses under constant and variable loads.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The anti-windup PID reduces overshoot to 5.42% (constant load) and 3.35% (variable load), compared to 13.26% and 23.76% for standard PID. Settling time improves by 31%, and steady-state error is near zero. The system demonstrates robustness across operating conditions.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Anti-windup PID significantly enhances BLDC motor control, making it ideal for EV applications. The low-cost Arduino-based implementation proves feasibility for real-world adoption. Future work includes adaptive gain scheduling for nonlinear loads.

title: Development of a Smart Water Dispenser Based on Object Recognition with Raspberry Pi 4
author: Dani Ramdani, Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Andriana, Tjahjo Adiprabowo, Yuyu Wahyu, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Sally Octaviana Sari, Zulkarnain, Noor Rohman

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Public water dispensers often waste water due to overfilling or misuse. This project develops a smart dispenser that automatically detects cups and fills them to the optimal level using computer vision and ultrasonic sensing.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system uses Raspberry Pi 4 with a camera and HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor. YOLOv8 detects cup presence and type, while OpenCV estimates volume. A DC pump is controlled via PWM based on real-time fill level. The software stack includes Python, OpenCV, and TensorFlow Lite.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Cup detection accuracy: 96.5%. Fill level precision: ±3 mL. Average dispensing time: 8.2 seconds. Water waste reduced by 74% compared to manual dispensers. The system handles multiple cup sizes and stops automatically when full.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This smart dispenser demonstrates how edge AI can promote sustainability in public facilities. The modular design allows integration with IoT platforms for usage analytics and maintenance alerts. Future versions will support voice commands and user authentication.

title: Rancang Bangun Content Management System Pada Website Riset Fakultas Teknik Universitas Nurtanio Menggunakan Bahasa Pemrograman PHP Dan MySQL
author: A. L. Ali, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Ike Yuni Wulandari, Heni Puspita

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Universitas Nurtanio requires a dynamic platform to showcase research activities. A custom Content Management System (CMS) enables non-technical staff to manage content without coding, improving information dissemination to students and stakeholders.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The CMS is built with PHP (Laravel framework) and MySQL. Features include user roles (admin, contributor), WYSIWYG editor, file upload, and responsive design. Development follows agile methodology with iterative testing by faculty members.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The system reduces content update time from 2 hours to 10 minutes per article. Uptime is 99.8% over 6 months. User satisfaction score: 4.3/5. It supports 50+ concurrent users during peak hours without performance degradation.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: The custom CMS meets the university’s need for a flexible, secure, and user-friendly research portal. Future enhancements include integration with Google Scholar API and multilingual support for international collaboration.

title: Pemodelan Dan Simulasi 6 Derajat Kebebasan Pesawat Udara Dengan Menggunakan Matlab/Simulink
author: Aulia Widya Prameswari, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, S. Yuniorrita Y.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Accurate aircraft simulation is vital for pilot training and control system design. This research implements a 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) model of a Boeing 757-like aircraft using MATLAB/Simulink, integrated with FlightGear for 3D visualization.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The model uses GARTEUR RCAM parameters. Longitudinal dynamics are nonlinear; lateral-directional are linearized. Control inputs: aileron, elevator, rudder deflections. Doublet inputs test system response from steady-level flight. Data is exchanged between Simulink and FlightGear via UDP.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Simulations show realistic pitch, roll, and yaw responses to control inputs. Pitch rate peaks at 2.1°/s for elevator doublet. Roll response time: 3.4 seconds. Integration with FlightGear provides immersive visualization with <100 ms latency.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: The 6-DOF simulator is a valuable tool for aerospace education and research. It can be extended to include wind turbulence, engine failure, and autopilot algorithms. The open architecture supports future hardware-in-the-loop testing.

title: An Elastic Frame Rate Up-Conversion for Sequential Omnidirectional Images
author: Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Salita Ulitia Prini, Syed Abdul Rahman Abu-Bakar, Yusuf Nur Wijayanto

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Omnidirectional videos suffer from low frame rates during transmission over lossy networks, causing motion jerkiness. This paper proposes E-FRUC: an elastic frame rate up-conversion algorithm that adaptively generates intermediate frames based on motion complexity.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: E-FRUC uses optical flow to estimate motion between consecutive 360° frames. A self-improvement mechanism refines flow vectors. The number of generated frames is proportional to motion intensity—more motion, more frames. Tested on 10 omnidirectional videos with synthetic and real motion.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: PSNR of reconstructed frames: 33–59 dB. Visual quality is rated 'excellent' by 89% of viewers. For high-motion scenes, E-FRUC generates up to 3 intermediate frames, smoothing playback. Processing time: 0.8s/frame on Intel i7 CPU.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: E-FRUC preserves motion continuity in omnidirectional video, enhancing user experience in VR and telepresence. Its adaptive nature makes it bandwidth-efficient. Future work includes GPU acceleration and integration with video codecs.

title: A Steering Stability Control for a Three-Wheeled Autonomous Electric Vehicle
author: Hilman Lajuardhie, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Adam Faroqi, Fauzan Ali Rasyid

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Three-wheeled electric vehicles offer compact mobility but face stability challenges during steering. This research designs a PID-based steering controller to ensure precise and stable directional control for autonomous operation.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Steering is actuated by a BLDC motor with gear reduction. PID gains are tuned using Ziegler-Nichols II method. The controller adjusts motor position based on desired vs. actual steering angle from an encoder. Tests include step and ramp inputs at 10–30 km/h.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The system achieves steering accuracy of ±0.8°. Overshoot is limited to 2.1%, and settling time is 0.9 seconds. Vehicle remains stable during sharp turns at 25 km/h. Power consumption is 12% lower than open-loop steering.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: The PID steering controller enhances safety and drivability of three-wheeled EVs. It forms a critical component of the vehicle’s autonomous stack. Future work includes integration with path-planning algorithms and obstacle avoidance.

title: 360-degree Image Processing on NVIDIA Jetson Nano
author: Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Prio Adjie Utomo, Heni Puspita, Ike Yuni Wulandari

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Autonomous vehicles require 360° vision for comprehensive environment perception. However, 360° cameras produce distorted equirectangular images. This research develops real-time normalization software on NVIDIA Jetson Nano to convert these into usable planar views.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system uses Python with OpenCV on Jetson Nano. It supports multiple projection types: perspective, cylindrical, and stereographic. Users select regions of interest (ROIs) for dewarping. Optimization includes CUDA acceleration and memory pooling for real-time performance.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Processing speed: 22 FPS for 4K input (3840x1920). Latency: 45 ms per frame. Memory usage: 380 MB. The normalized output enables standard object detectors (e.g., YOLO) to run without modification, achieving 94% mAP on KITTI-360 dataset.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This lightweight 360° processing pipeline makes omnidirectional vision accessible on edge devices. It bridges the gap between specialized 360° sensors and conventional computer vision algorithms. Code will be open-sourced to support autonomous vehicle research in resource-constrained settings.

title: PENGEMBANGAN MODEL CAPSULEGAN UNTUK PENGHAPUSAN HUJAN CITRA TUNGGAL
author: Haryanto Hidayat, Munawir Munawir, Muhammad Taufik Dwi Putra, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Rain streaks severely degrade image quality, causing loss of spatial information critical for computer vision tasks. Traditional deraining methods often fail to preserve structural details, while standard GANs struggle with spatial relationships between rain components. This research proposes CapsuleGAN—a hybrid model combining Capsule Networks (CapsNet) and GANs—to effectively remove rain while preserving object geometry.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: CapsuleGAN integrates CapsNet into the discriminator to better capture spatial hierarchies (pose, position, orientation) of rain streaks. The generator uses U-Net architecture with residual blocks. Training is performed on Rain100L and SPA-Data datasets. Performance is evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, and visual inspection against DCGAN, RESCAN, and PReNet.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: CapsuleGAN achieves PSNR of 31.2 dB and SSIM of 0.94 on Rain100L, outperforming baseline models. It effectively removes dense rain streaks without blurring object edges. Qualitative results show superior preservation of texture and fine details (e.g., text, facial features) compared to competitors.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: By leveraging CapsNet’s ability to model part-whole relationships, CapsuleGAN significantly improves single-image deraining. Future work includes real-time optimization for autonomous driving and extension to video deraining with temporal consistency.

title: Model Deep Learning untuk Klasifikasi Objek pada Gambar Fisheye
author: Riza Ayu Putri, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Johanes Adi Prihantono, Rinda Safana Linggi, I Gusti Ayu Putri Surya Paramita, Ni Kadek Emy Iswarawati, Fabian Akbar, Prio Adjie Utomo

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Fisheye cameras offer a 180° field of view, ideal for surveillance and autonomous systems, but introduce severe distortion that challenges object recognition. This study develops CNN-based models to classify human objects in fisheye images, addressing distortion through tailored architecture design.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Four CNN models (1, 2, 3, and 7 layers) are trained on a custom dataset of 900 fisheye images of humans. Data augmentation includes rotation, scaling, and distortion simulation. Models are implemented in TensorFlow and evaluated using precision, recall, and accuracy.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The 7-layer CNN achieves the best performance: precision = 98.56%, recall = 98.50%, accuracy = 98.59%. Deeper networks better handle distortion-induced feature shifts. Inference time is 23 ms/image on NVIDIA GTX 1660, suitable for real-time applications.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Deep CNNs can effectively classify objects in fisheye images without explicit undistortion. The 7-layer model is recommended for deployment in security and autonomous vehicle systems. Future work will explore transformer-based architectures for improved generalization.

title: PENGEMBANGAN SISTEM KOMBINASI KERJA REM, STEER, DAN TRAKSI BERBASIS LiDAR 3D UNTUK KENDARAAN LISTRIK OTONOM RODA TIGA
author: Fabian Akbar, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Ike Yuni Wulandari, Prio Adjie Utomo, Riza Ayu Putri, I Gusti Ayu Putri Surya Paramita, Ni Kadek Emy Iswarawati, Rinda Safana Linggi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: While LiDAR-based object detection has advanced, its integration with vehicle control systems (braking, steering, traction) remains limited. This research implements a closed-loop safety and guidance system for a three-wheeled autonomous electric vehicle using 3D LiDAR perception.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system uses a 3D LiDAR to detect obstacles within 5 meters. A Mamdani fuzzy logic controller generates maneuver commands based on distance and angle. Processing is split: perception on Jetson AGX Xavier (Python), control execution on Teensy 4.1 microcontroller. The vehicle integrates BLDC motors for traction, steering, and regenerative braking.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The system successfully avoids static and moving obstacles at speeds up to 15 km/h. Average reaction time: 0.8 seconds. Fuzzy logic ensures smooth deceleration and steering, preventing abrupt maneuvers. Power consumption is reduced by 12% through regenerative braking.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This end-to-end LiDAR-to-control pipeline demonstrates a practical, low-cost approach to autonomous vehicle safety. The modular design allows adaptation to different vehicle platforms. Future work includes multi-sensor fusion with cameras and radar.

title: An Efficient Hardware Implementation of FPGA-Based Stereo Matching Using a Single Path SGM Direction
author: Iman Firmansyah, Bambang Setiadi, Ratna Indrawijaya, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Dayat Kurniawan, AA Waskita

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Stereo matching is vital for depth estimation in robotics and ADAS, but high hardware cost limits deployment on low-end FPGAs. This paper presents an optimized FPGA implementation using minimal resources while maintaining disparity accuracy.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The design uses Sum of Absolute Differences (SAD) with a tiny 4×4 window buffer and a single-path Semi-Global Matching (SGM) to reduce memory and logic usage. Implemented on Xilinx Zynq XC7Z020, the system processes 640×480 images at 30 FPS. Resource utilization is compared against full SGM and block-matching approaches.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The single-path SGM reduces LUT usage by 62% and BRAM by 48% compared to full SGM, with only 5% drop in disparity accuracy (Bad3 < 8%). Power consumption is 1.2 W, enabling battery-operated applications. The design fits on low-cost Artix-7 FPGAs.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This efficient stereo matcher makes real-time depth perception accessible for resource-constrained embedded systems. The single-path SGM is a practical trade-off for applications where hardware cost is critical. Code and bitstream will be open-sourced.

title: Strategies to Improve LoRaWAN Performance in Multi Communication Use Listen Before Talk
author: Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Fairuz Iqbal Maulana, Pradeka Brilyan Purwandoko, Tjahjo Adiprabowo, Yudi Yulius Maulana, Sofyan Mufti Prasetyo, Yuyu Wahyu, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Muhammad Yasir

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: LoRaWAN suffers from high packet loss in dense deployments due to uncoordinated ALOHA-based access. This research evaluates Listen-Before-Talk (LBT) as a medium access control (MAC) enhancement to reduce collisions in multi-communication scenarios.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: A testbed with 50 LoRa nodes simulates intelligent transportation and supply chain use cases. LBT is compared against standard ALOHA and Adaptive Data Rate (ADR). Metrics: collision rate, packet delivery ratio (PDR), and energy per packet. LBT uses energy detection threshold of -100 dBm.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: LBT reduces collision rate to 10%, versus 20% for ADR and 40% for ALOHA. PDR improves to 92% (vs. 85% and 70%). Energy per packet increases by 8% due to sensing overhead, but overall network efficiency rises by 35%.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: LBT is a viable MAC-layer solution for high-density LoRaWAN networks. Regulatory support for duty-cycle relaxation in sub-GHz bands would further enhance its effectiveness. The approach is recommended for urban IoT deployments.

title: Design and Development of a 3D Object Imaging System Using Biaxial LiDAR with a Combined Motor Servo
author: Agitta Rianaris, Asep Hapiddin, Hari Pratomo, Osen Fili Nami, Eko Joni Pristianto, Dayat Kurniawan, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Yomi Guno, Dwi Hanto

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: High-cost LiDAR technologies (MEMS, solid-state) limit accessibility for research and SMEs. This paper presents a low-cost 3D imaging system using biaxial mechanical LiDAR with servo motors, offering real-time point cloud generation at a fraction of commercial prices.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system combines a time-of-flight laser module with two orthogonal servo motors for azimuth and elevation scanning. Control and data processing are handled by an ESP32 microcontroller. Point clouds are visualized in real-time using Python and Open3D. Calibration corrects for servo nonlinearity and timing jitter.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The prototype achieves 0.5° angular resolution and 2 cm depth accuracy at 5 m range. Scan rate: 5 Hz for 180°×90° FOV. Total cost: under $150. Real-time visualization runs at 10 FPS on a standard laptop. The system successfully reconstructs complex objects like chairs and mannequins.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: This biaxial LiDAR system provides an affordable entry point for 3D perception research and education. Future work includes multi-echo support and integration with SLAM algorithms for mobile robotics.

title: Bandwidth-Efficient Image Transmission in Autonomous Vehicles Using Super-Resolution Techniques
author: Mokhammad Mirza Etnisa Haqiqi, Ajib Setyo Arifin, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Anindya Afina Carmelya, Salita Ulitia Prini

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Autonomous vehicles generate massive visual data, straining communication bandwidth. This research proposes a bandwidth-efficient transmission scheme: send low-resolution images and apply super-resolution (SR) at the receiver to reconstruct high-quality frames.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system uses ESRGAN for SR reconstruction. Original 1080p images are downsampled to 270p for transmission. End-to-end latency and reconstruction quality are measured over 4G/5G links. Object detection accuracy (YOLOv5) is used as a downstream task metric.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Bandwidth usage drops by 89% (from 12 Mbps to 1.3 Mbps). SR-reconstructed images achieve 29.1 dB PSNR and maintain 94% object detection mAP (vs. 96% for original). Total latency (transmit + SR) is 180 ms, acceptable for non-safety-critical cloud offloading.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Super-resolution enables significant bandwidth savings without compromising perception performance. This approach is ideal for fleet management, remote diagnostics, and V2N applications. Future work will explore lightweight SR models for edge deployment.

title: Sistem Pengendali Steering Gear Otomatis Menggunakan Teknologi Kamera Thermal FLIR
author: Rachmat Arifyandy, Fiky Y Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Autonomous vehicles must operate reliably in all lighting conditions. Thermal cameras offer all-weather, day-night perception capability. This research develops an automatic steering system using FLIR thermal imaging and deep learning for robust object detection.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: A FLIR Lepton camera captures thermal images. ResNet-50 is fine-tuned on a thermal dataset of roads and obstacles. Detected object positions guide a PID-based steering controller on a three-wheeled EV. Tests are conducted in daylight, night, and foggy conditions.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Object detection accuracy: 96.2% in daylight, 94.8% at night, 91.3% in fog. Steering system maintains lane centering with ±5 cm deviation. Thermal imaging enables detection of pedestrians and animals invisible to visible-light cameras in darkness.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Thermal vision significantly enhances autonomous vehicle safety in low-visibility conditions. The ResNet-50 + PID pipeline is robust and low-latency. Future work includes multi-spectral fusion with visible and radar data.

title: Realsense Depth Camera Untuk Pengukuran Jarak Pada Mobil Autonom Roda Tiga
author: Ferryn Marchellyn, Fiky Y Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Accurate distance measurement is fundamental for obstacle avoidance in autonomous vehicles. Intel RealSense depth cameras provide dense, real-time depth maps. This study evaluates the D435i for distance estimation on a three-wheeled autonomous platform.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The D435i is mounted on the vehicle and connected to a laptop for processing. Objects within 8 meters are detected using YOLOv5, and distances are extracted from the depth map. Non-Max Suppression (NMS) filters overlapping bounding boxes. Tests vary speed (5–20 km/h), lighting, and object types.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Distance accuracy: ±2 cm at 1–3 m, ±5 cm at 3–6 m, ±10 cm at 6–8 m. Detection latency: 65 ms. Performance is stable across lighting conditions but degrades slightly in direct sunlight due to IR interference.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: RealSense D435i is a reliable, cost-effective solution for short-range depth perception in autonomous vehicles. Its integration with standard object detectors simplifies development. Recommendations include sunshade installation and fusion with LiDAR for long-range coverage.

title: Ilustrasi Pengereman Kendaraan Otonom Roda Tiga Menggunakan Aktuator Linear Elektrik
author: Fiky Y Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Precise braking control is essential for autonomous vehicle safety. This research implements an electric linear actuator-based braking system for a three-wheeled EV, enabling programmable deceleration profiles based on obstacle distance.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: An Intel RealSense D415 depth camera detects obstacles. An ATmega2560 Pro microcontroller processes distance data and drives a BTS7960 motor driver to control the linear actuator. Three PWM segments define braking intensity: 255 (2–4 m), 100 (4–6 m), 60 (6–8 m).

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: The system achieves braking response in <1 second. Deceleration is smooth and proportional to distance, avoiding abrupt stops. Energy recovery via regenerative braking is integrated. The actuator provides 500 N force, sufficient for emergency stops at 20 km/h.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Electric linear actuators offer a simple, reliable braking solution for small autonomous vehicles. The distance-adaptive control enhances passenger comfort and safety. Future work will add anti-lock braking (ABS) logic.

title: Pemanfaatan Intel RealSense Depth Camera D415 untuk Mendeteksi Manusia pada Kendaraan Otonom Roda Tiga
author: Felicia Bunga Aurelia, Fiky Y Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Human detection is critical for urban autonomous vehicles to ensure pedestrian safety. This study implements a real-time human detection system using Intel RealSense D415 depth camera on a three-wheeled autonomous platform.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: The system combines RGB and depth data from D415. A YOLOv5 model is fine-tuned on a custom dataset of humans in urban environments. Depth information validates detections and estimates distance. Processing runs on an embedded Jetson Nano.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Detection accuracy: 97.3% mAP at 15 FPS. False positives are reduced by 40% using depth validation. Distance estimation error: <5% within 6 meters. The system reliably detects partially occluded pedestrians and children.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Fusing RGB and depth data significantly improves human detection robustness. The RealSense-based system is cost-effective and suitable for low-speed autonomous vehicles in campus or residential areas. Future work includes tracking and intent prediction.

title: Kendali Kemudi Dengan Memindai Area Jalan Berbasis Kamera Termal
author: Sebastian Edward Siburian, Fiky Y Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Road segmentation is essential for autonomous navigation. Thermal cameras provide consistent imaging in darkness and adverse weather. This research develops a thermal-based road segmentation system using deep learning for steering control.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: A FLIR thermal camera captures road scenes. Semantic segmentation models (ResNet-18/34/50/101/152, ResNeXt-50) are trained on a thermal road dataset. The best model guides a steering controller via lane center estimation. Tests are conducted day and night on urban and rural roads.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: ResNet-50 achieves the best balance: 95.7% IoU and 22 FPS on Jetson AGX. Night performance matches daytime (IoU drop <1%). The system enables stable autonomous driving at 15 km/h with ±8 cm lateral error. Thermal imaging outperforms visible-light in fog and glare.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Thermal-based road segmentation enables all-weather autonomous navigation. ResNet-50 is recommended for embedded deployment. Future work includes dynamic obstacle integration and multi-camera fusion for 360° coverage.

title: Optimasi Penggunaan Kamera FLIR Untuk Navigasi Pada Sistem Kemudi Otomatis
author: Mahesa Wisnu Suputra, Fiky Y Suratman, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Sistem kemudi otomatis harus beroperasi di berbagai kondisi pencahayaan, termasuk malam hari dan cuaca buruk. Kamera FLIR (Forward-Looking Infrared) menawarkan solusi dengan kemampuan pencitraan termal yang tidak bergantung pada cahaya tampak. Penelitian ini mengoptimalkan penggunaan kamera FLIR untuk navigasi kendaraan listrik otonom (KLO).

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Sistem menggunakan kamera FLIR Lepton 3.5 yang terintegrasi dengan mikrokontroler. Citra termal diproses menggunakan CNN berbasis ResNet-50 yang dilatih pada dataset lokal berisi objek jalan, pejalan kaki, dan kendaraan dalam kondisi siang, malam, dan berkabut. Output deteksi digunakan untuk mengarahkan sistem kemudi PID.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Kamera FLIR berhasil mendeteksi objek dengan akurasi 95.2% di siang hari dan 93.7% di malam hari. Sistem kemudi mampu mempertahankan jalur dengan deviasi lateral rata-rata ±6 cm. Konsumsi daya sistem: 8.2 W, memungkinkan operasi hingga 6 jam dengan baterai 50 Wh.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: Kamera FLIR terbukti andal untuk navigasi otonom sepanjang waktu. Integrasi dengan ResNet-50 memberikan deteksi objek yang akurat meskipun dalam kondisi pencahayaan ekstrem. Sistem ini ideal untuk kendaraan otonom di area kampus, pabrik, atau perumahan.

title: Implementation of U-Net for Aerial Imagery Segmentation
author: Muhamad Dika, Suharjanto Utomo, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Segmentasi citra udara penting untuk pemetaan lingkungan, pemantauan pertanian, dan manajemen sumber daya. U-Net, dengan arsitektur encoder-decoder dan skip connections, sangat cocok untuk tugas segmentasi semantik beresolusi tinggi.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Dataset citra udara diambil dari Google Earth, mencakup sawah, bangunan, dan landasan pacu. Data diannotasi secara manual dan ditingkatkan dengan augmentasi (rotasi, flip, scaling). Model U-Net dilatih menggunakan loss function dice coefficient dan optimizer Adam dengan learning rate 0.001.

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Model mencapai mAP 0.89 dan IoU 0.84 pada validasi. Sawah dan landasan tersegmentasi dengan akurasi >90%, sedangkan bangunan mencapai 78% karena variasi bentuk dan bayangan. Waktu inferensi: 0.4 detik per gambar (512×512) pada GPU NVIDIA RTX 3060.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: U-Net terbukti efektif untuk segmentasi citra udara. Hasil ini mendukung penggunaan drone untuk pemantauan pertanian presisi dan perencanaan tata ruang. Penelitian lanjutan akan mengeksplorasi model berbasis transformer untuk penanganan objek kompleks.

title: LoRaWAN-Based Communication for Autonomous Vehicles: Performance and Development
author: Saharuna Saharuna, Tjahjo Adiprabowo, Muhammad Yassir, Dian Nurdiana, Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi, Akio Kitagawa, Arief Suryadi Satyawan

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Komunikasi data antar kendaraan otonom dan infrastruktur sangat penting untuk keselamatan dan koordinasi. LoRaWAN menawarkan jangkauan jauh dan konsumsi daya rendah, tetapi rentan terhadap tabrakan data di lingkungan padat.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Penelitian ini menganalisis kinerja LoRaWAN dalam skenario kendaraan otonom menggunakan simulator NS-3. Parameter yang dievaluasi: collision rate, packet delivery ratio (PDR), dan latency. Strategi mitigasi termasuk adaptive data rate (ADR), time-slotted channel hopping, dan listen-before-talk (LBT).

sections.heading: Results
sections.content: Tanpa mitigasi, collision rate mencapai 35% pada 50 node. Dengan LBT + ADR, collision turun menjadi 9%, PDR meningkat ke 94%, dan latency rata-rata 1.2 detik. Jangkauan komunikasi: 2.8 km di area perkotaan terbuka.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.content: LoRaWAN layak untuk komunikasi kendaraan otonom di area terbatas seperti kampus atau kawasan industri. Kombinasi LBT dan ADR secara signifikan meningkatkan keandalan. Penelitian ini mendukung integrasi LoRaWAN dalam ekosistem Smart City.

title: SRCNN-based image transmission for autonomous vehicles in limited network areas
author: Anindya Afina Carmelya, Arief Suryadi Satyawan, Galura Muhammad Suranegara, Mokhamamad Mirza Etnisa Haqiqi, Helfy Susilawati, Nizar Alam Hamdani, Puput Dani Prasetyo Adi

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: Transmisi gambar beresolusi tinggi di jaringan terbatas (seperti IEEE 802.11ac atau LoRa) menimbulkan tantangan bandwidth. Penelitian ini menggunakan SRCNN (Super-Resolution CNN) untuk mengirim gambar resolusi rendah dan merekonstruksinya di sisi penerima.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.content: Tiga model SRCNN (915, 935, 955) dilatih pada dataset lokal dengan input 128–256 piksel dan output 256–512 piksel. Evaluasi menggunakan PSNR, SSIM, dan akurasi deteksi objek (YOLOv5) sebagai metrik downstream.

sections.heading: Results
